data.content_ref: inline:The ritual itself is the bug: the adjudication-ritual's §11.3 flagging criterion conflates 'critic failed on artifact X' with 'critic is unreliable', and the nu-verdict system's independent confirmation of soundness on SRC_005 is being ignored by the ritual's binary pass/fail logic — the ritual should weight the nu-verdict evidence (SRC_006, SRC_008) as exonerating and de-sustain the flags, but its design lacks a reconciliation pathway between critic-level failures and verdict-level validations.
